name: @athenode/cli
stderr:
Usage: athenode [options] [command]

CLI for athenode: project scaffold, config, and tokens.

Options:
  -V, --version               print the CLI version
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  init|i [options]            Generate skills, subagents, rules and MCP servers
                              for the selected ones of the 30 supported AI tools
                              from an agent setup, show a plan of the changes,
                              and apply it after confirmation. A tool that loads
                              a plugin from the project gets the setup as a
                              plugin (the package under .athenode/plugins/ and a
                              declaration in the tool's local settings file, or
                              the package in the tool's plugin directory); every
                              other tool, and a plugin tool another selected
                              tool is incompatible with, gets files. The plan
                              states the format of each tool.
  use [options] <entry-slug>  Install the latest version of a publicly displayed
                              setup library entry into this directory, without a
                              token or an Athenode project: for the selected AI
                              tools, like `init`, with the plugin and its
                              commands named after the entry. A repeated run
                              updates the installation to the latest version, or
                              reports it as up to date. In a project installed
                              with `init` it asks first (or needs --force). Run
                              `init` later to connect an Athenode project
                              instead.
  specs|s                     Manage specifications via the athenode REST API.
  todos                       Manage ToDo cards (follow-ups, tech debt, bugs and
                              ideas noted while working) via the athenode REST
                              API.
  setups                      Browse and edit an installed agent setup's file
                              tree, and manage agent setups, via the athenode
                              REST API.
  agents                      Manage agents attached to the installed agent
                              setup (or, with --setup-id, another setup of the
                              project), via the athenode REST API.
  skills                      Manage skills attached to the installed agent
                              setup (or, with --setup-id, another setup of the
                              project), via the athenode REST API.
  mcp-servers                 Manage setup-level MCP servers attached to the
                              installed agent setup (or, with --setup-id,
                              another setup of the project), via the athenode
                              REST API.
  rules                       Manage the rules text blob for the installed agent
                              setup (or, with --setup-id, another setup of the
                              project), via the athenode REST API.
  library                     Browse the public setup library, add or merge its
                              entries into the project's setups, update setups
                              added from it, and publish setups to it, via the
                              athenode REST API.
  mcp [options]               Start a stdio MCP server (server name "athenode")
                              exposing every CLI command except init as a tool.
  help [command]              display help for command
